relations.subject: Hermann Beckh
relations.evidence: He later took up the study of oriental languages, Indology, and Tibetology at the Christian-Albrechts-Universität at Kiel.

relations.subject: Hermann Beckh
relations.evidence: In 1907, he received his doctorate at Humboldt-Universität at Berlin with a thesis on Kalidasa's poem Meghaduta.

relations.subject: Hermann Beckh
relations.evidence: He taught as a private tutor of the Tibetan language until 1921 and worked cataloguing Tibetan manuscripts at the Staatsbibliothek in Berlin.

relations.subject: Hermann Beckh
relations.object: Institut für Weltwirtschaft an der Universität Kiel
relations.evidence: he was called to work in the Institut für Weltwirtschaft an der Universität Kiel (Kiel Institute for the World Economy)
